title: GOD OF THUNDER
overview: Ichigo, Orihime and Chad head out to defeat Yhwach while Yoruichi clashes with Nakk Le Vaar.

title: SON OF DARKNESS
overview: The battle between Nakk Le Vaar, Yoruichi and Urahara rages and Ichigo and Orihime confront Yhwach.

title: BLOOD FOR MY BONE
overview: Ichigo and Orihime confront Yhwach in a battle that will shape the fate of the Three Worlds.

title: THE PERFECT CRIMSON
overview: Gerard's ability remains unbroken, while Ichigo endures Yhwach's fierce assault.

title: DEFEND YOU
overview: Confronting Yhwach, Ichigo awakens the power of the Hollow deep within, becoming Demi-Hollowfied.

title: THE END
overview: The battle between Uryu and Haschwalth intensifies and nears its conclusion.

title: THE END 2
overview: Ichigo's Bankai fails to reach Yhwach.
